faqs.q: Do I need to install an app?
faqs.a: No. Stockwise runs in a phone or computer browser, with nothing to install. Just open it, sign up, and start.

faqs.q: Do I need old sales data?
faqs.a: No. Start from day one. Shopping suggestions appear once a session has been closed, and are marked “not much data yet” until there is enough data.

faqs.q: I sell alone, is that okay?
faqs.a: Yes. One Owner account is enough for POS, stock, and reports. Cashier accounts for staff are only needed if you have staff.
No. Cashier accounts only run sales and daily sessions. Reports, costs, cost of goods, and settings are visible to the Owner only.

faqs.q: What if I forget to close the stall?
faqs.a: The system closes the session automatically 30 minutes after closing time, using recorded stock as leftovers. Ingredients that can be carried over move to tomorrow; the rest are counted as discarded.

faqs.q: Is my business data separate and deletable?
faqs.a: Yes. One business's data is never visible to another. The Owner can permanently delete the business and all its data by typing the business name to confirm.

docs.title: How to use Stockwise, step by step.
docs.lead: Follow the sections below in order for your first day. After that, come back to the section you need.

sections.title: Sign up and log in
steps: Click **Sign up** at the top right and enter your name, email, and password (8–72 characters).
After signing up, you go straight to business setup.
Next time, use **Log in** with the same email and password.
tips: Accounts created through Sign up are always owners. Cashier accounts are created by the owner in Settings.

sections.title: Set up your business
sections.lead: Three steps, under 10 minutes. You can stop and come back later with **Save and exit**.
steps: **Business profile**: enter your business name, opening time, closing time, and currency.
**Ingredients**: add everything you stock, like flour (grams) or eggs (pieces), with an estimated price. Mark one ingredient as the **main item**.
**Products & recipes**: add what you sell, pick the ingredients and amount per portion, then set a selling price. The estimated cost per portion and a suggested price appear automatically.
On the **Done** page, check that every requirement is met, then go open your stall.
tips: The main item is the ingredient that matters most to your sales. Stockwise records when it sells out and calculates how much to buy.
The currency locks once you open your stall for the first time, because recorded amounts are not converted.
The closing time is used to close your stall automatically if you forget.

sections.title: Open your stall
sections.lead: Done every morning before selling, by the owner or a cashier.
steps: From **Home**, click **Open stall**.
Check the **In stock** column: these are leftovers from your last close, calculated automatically.
For what you bought this morning, fill in **+ Add** and **Total paid**. Or click **Fill suggested amounts** to use the shopping suggestion.
Click **Review**, check the opening stock, then **Open stall**.
tips: Leave Add and Total paid empty if you bought nothing for that ingredient.
Just enter the total you paid. The unit price and cost of goods are calculated for you.
You can open before your opening time. Once closed, the stall can only reopen tomorrow.

sections.title: Sell at the cashier
sections.lead: Record sales as fast as you take payment.
steps: Open **Cashier**.
Tap a product to add it to the cart. Use − and + to change the amount.
Choose a payment method. For cash, enter the amount received if you want to see the change.
Click **Pay**. Once saved, print a receipt if needed, then **New transaction** (or press Enter).
tips: Too busy to record each sale? Switch to **Recap** mode, enter the total sold per product, and save it as one transaction.
Products whose ingredients ran out are marked **Sold out** and can't be added.
On a phone, the cart is below the product list. Tap the **View cart** bar to jump there.

sections.title: Void a transaction
sections.lead: Made a mistake? Void the transaction and the stock comes back automatically.
steps: Open **Transaction history** and click the wrong transaction.
Click **Void transaction** and enter a reason.
The transaction is marked Voided and its ingredients go back into stock.
tips: You can only void while the stall is still open.
Voided transactions stay visible in the history and reports, with their reason.

sections.title: Close your stall
sections.lead: Under two minutes at night, and it makes tomorrow's suggestion more accurate.
steps: From **Home**, click **Close stall**.
Count what is left of each ingredient and fill in **Counted**. If it matches the record, click **Use recorded stock**.
For each ingredient, choose **Keep** (carried to tomorrow) or **Discard**.
Add a note if you like, such as "rain since the afternoon", then click **Close stall**.
tips: Any difference between recorded and counted stock is recorded as a stock difference cost.
Ingredients that can't be carried over can only be discarded.
Forgot to close? The system closes it 30 minutes after closing time, using recorded stock.
Session data can't be changed after the stall is closed.

sections.title: Read your summary and shopping suggestion
sections.lead: As soon as the stall closes, the day's results and tomorrow's suggestion show up on Home.
steps: See **Today's summary** on Home: revenue, cost of goods, profit, and leftovers carried to tomorrow.
See the **shopping suggestion** for tomorrow, with a range and reasons. Click **Why this much?** to see the calculation.
Want a plain-language review? Click **Make insight**.
tips: Suggestions get better after a few days of data. At first, they are estimated from your recipes.
Insight only receives summary numbers, never names or emails, and the number of tries per session is limited.

sections.title: Reports, trends, and Excel
sections.lead: For details on one day or how things went over several weeks.
steps: Open **Daily report** to see profit, sales by hour, payment methods, products, and stock. Use the date arrows to switch days.
Click **View trend** to see revenue and profit over a date range, by day or by week.
Click **Download Excel** to download sales data for the day or range you are viewing.
tips: Reports only exist for days whose stall has been closed.
A trend range can be up to 366 days.

sections.title: Manage ingredients and products
sections.lead: Change your ingredients, recipes, and prices any time.
steps: Open **Ingredients** to add, edit, or deactivate ingredients.
Open **Products and recipes** to change recipes and selling prices. Check the cost, margin, and suggested price columns.
Ingredients or products you no longer use can simply be deactivated. Their history is kept.
tips: An ingredient still used in a recipe must be removed from that recipe before it can be deactivated.
An ingredient's unit can't be changed once it has been used in a session.
A cost marked Estimate means an ingredient hasn't been bought through Open stall yet.

sections.title: Cashier accounts and settings
sections.lead: Add cashiers, change the language, and tune suggestions.
steps: Open **Settings** and click **Add cashier**. Enter a name, email, and password, then give them to your cashier.
In **Business profile**, change your opening hours or business name. Hour changes apply from the next session.
Open **Advanced settings** to change the stock suggestion buffer, target margin, and paydays.
tips: Cashiers can only open and close the stall, record sales, and see that day's transactions.
A deactivated cashier can't log in anymore. Their transaction history is kept.
Each account picks its own language in Settings.

faq.q: I forgot to close the stall. What happens?
faq.a: The system closes it automatically 30 minutes after closing time, using recorded stock. Ingredients that can be carried over are carried to tomorrow.

faq.q: Can I open the stall twice in one day?
faq.a: No. One session per day. Once closed, the stall can only reopen tomorrow.

faq.q: I entered the wrong count when closing. Can I change it?
faq.a: No. Session data is final once closed. The difference is corrected when you check the stock at your next Open stall.

faq.q: Why is there no shopping suggestion yet?
faq.a: Suggestions are made after the stall closes. Close today's stall, then check Home.

faq.q: My business stays open past midnight. Can I use Stockwise?
faq.a: Not yet. The closing time must be after the opening time on the same day.
